name: dns-doctor
description: Diagnose and fix a domain's email authentication (SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MX, blacklist, expiry). Returns deterministic verdicts and copy-paste fix records generated by a validating engine — never a guessed record.

interface.shortDescription: Scan and fix a domain's email authentication — SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MX, blacklist, expiry.
interface.longDescription: DNS Doctor scans a domain's email-authentication posture and returns deterministic verdicts plus copy-paste fix records generated by a validating engine (RFC grammar plus the SPF 10-lookup counter) — never an LLM guess. It diagnoses SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MX, DNS health, blacklist listings, and domain/SSL expiry; builds alignment-gated DMARC enforcement upgrades (p=reject only when the server-derived alignment gate passes); and can email a human a double-opt-in link to start free DMARC monitoring — nothing is created until they click. A human approves every DNS change.
defaultPrompt: Scan my domain for email authentication problems and explain anything that is failing.
Mail from my domain keeps landing in spam — diagnose it and give me the exact DNS records to fix.
Is it safe to move my domain's DMARC policy to enforcement? If yes, give me the record to publish.
